regime_context: The TSX detector shows Big Banks as the dominant theme (score 1.53, durability 0.72) but crowded. Rotation is broad (69% eligible) with a wide leader–challenger margin and no directional handoff signal. The absolute-trend gate provides validated drawdown control; momentum rank has no forecasting edge. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines—coincident context, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream is the highest-ranked challenger (score 0.86, durability 0.77, trend tag) but has no scorable ETF. Monitor for a narrowing rotation margin below 0.2 and Big Banks’ eligibility/deterioration; a confirmed handoff would change the leader structure. Kill criterion: if Big Banks remains leader with margin >0.3 and eligible, Pipelines stays a watch only.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate keeps Big Banks eligible, confirming an intact uptrend. Durability is moderately high (0.72) and breadth is perfect (1.0), suggesting broad participation. Crowding is a sizing caution—cap exposure—but the trend discipline supports staying with the leader. Momentum rank is an attention lens, not a buy signal, so the lean is purely a trend-following risk allocation.
evidence: gate_helps: true (abs-trend gate validated for drawdown reduction)
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.2, crowded=true) and high momentum score could mean the move is extended, making it vulnerable to a sharp reversal on any credit or macro shock. A mean-reversion episode could undercut the trend.

falsifier.text: Big Banks becomes ineligible per the absolute-trend gate (trend breaks) OR its durability_bar falls below 0.5 within the 30-day horizon.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are not eligible per the absolute-trend gate, indicating a missing sustained uptrend. Score is negative (-0.307) and durability very low (0.33). The detector’s only validated edge—drawdown avoidance by staying out of non-eligible themes—argues for underweighting to reduce portfolio volatility and tail risk.
evidence: gate_helps: true (abs-trend gate validated for risk control)
theses.dissent: A geopolitical or gold-price shock could trigger a rapid rally in gold miners, making the underweight a missed opportunity. The theme’s low durability may reverse quickly if sentiment flips.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners’ absolute-trend gate flips to eligible AND durability_bar rises above 0.5 within 30 days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
